title: macOS App Deployment & Apple VPP with Microsoft Intune (App Store + Enterprise Apps)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (macOS + Microsoft Intune/Entra; configuration/identity/security work, live-fleet care).
White-label; Apple/Microsoft console internals authored click-by-click from public docs; anything uncertain flagged, not invented.
hook: Deliver and license Mac apps without touching the device
problem: Getting the right apps — App Store and enterprise — onto managed Macs, licensed and updated, is a persistent gap. This solution stands up macOS app deployment through Microsoft Intune with Apple's Volume Purchase Program (VPP): connect the ABM/VPP token, sync licenses, deploy store and line-of-business apps, and keep them updated — deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the macOS app-delivery model in Intune (VPP location tokens, device- vs user-licensing, store apps, LOB .pkg/.dmg, unmanaged PKG) and the deployment model.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites (ABM + VPP location + token, Intune app connector, Entra groups, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.
Implementation Guide — exact steps to connect the VPP token, sync licenses, add and assign store + enterprise apps to the named pilot group, validate install/licensing, then expand.
5 PowerShell scripts — app/VPP-token discovery, per-device app + license validation, an app/VPP-license coverage report, safe remediation of failed installs/licenses, and a target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (app installed, licensed, updated) plus Best Practices for token renewal and licensing model.
short: Deploy and license Mac apps via Intune + Apple VPP — App Store and enterprise apps, token/license sync, updates — without touching the device, deployed pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Deploy and license Mac apps via Intune + Apple VPP — App Store and enterprise apps, token/license sync, updates — without touching the device, pilot-first.
